API_OR_LIBRARY_SURFACE.rationale: Generic conjunction receives only a coarse distinction between canonical surface and compatibility-relevant noncanonical surfaces.

COMPILER_OR_LANGUAGE_RESOLUTION.rationale: Generic conjunction treats implicit/sugar-mediated resolution geometries as one trigger class.

RUNTIME_LOADING_OR_CAPABILITY.rationale: Generic conjunction treats non-explicit-marker loading paths as one trigger class.

DEPENDENCY_OR_TYPE_EVOLUTION.rationale: Generic conjunction treats compatibility-facing source/binary surfaces as one trigger class.

separator_rule: If two distinct G1 states under the same frozen semantic X and E require different actions, the binary generic conjunction fails while the typed geometry representation survives if it predicted/encoded that distinction prospectively.
